[SWS_CM_00265] Datatype for the length field of associative maps
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00201, RS_CM_00202, RS_CM_00211
⌈
If
TransformationPropsToServiceInterfaceElementMapping
.
transfor-
mationProps
.
sizeOfArrayLengthField
defines the data type for the length field
of an associative map, the data shall be:
•
std::uint8
if
sizeOfArrayLengthField
equals 1
•
std::uint16
if
sizeOfArrayLengthField
equals 2
•
std::uint32
if
sizeOfArrayLengthField
equals 4
